description: Bornes fontaines - Ville de Clermont-Ferrand is a dataset listed in Open Data Clermont-Ferrand, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ville de Clermont-Ferrand. Ce jeu de données géolocalise les bornes fontaines à manivelle à Clermont-Ferrand. Coverage: Clermont-Ferrand. The portal files it under Espace public. Its keywords are Eau, Fontaines, Fraîcheur, Îlots, Potable, Clermont-Ferrand. The portal shows 64 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-02-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-clermont-ferrand-fr-portal.
